It is made exclusively from tea grown in the United States, but it is not a cultivar, a protected origin or a generic “Charleston-style” black tea. The garden's own material supplies the usable facts: 127 acres, more than 320 tea varieties, a history that runs from Charles Shepard's Pinehurst plantation in 1888 to the 1963 transplant at Wadmalaw Island, commercial operation in 1987 and Bigelow ownership from 2003. The tea itself is a larger-leaf black tea; the official brewing suggestion is 8 ounces of boiling water for 2–4 minutes, hot or iced. The page deliberately leaves cultivar and CTC/Orthodox claims out because the official pages do not publish them.

title: 夏威夷火山绿茶
summary: 夏威夷火山绿茶是夏威夷大岛火山高地所产绿茶的区域称呼，重点在 Volcano（约 4,000 英尺）和 Mauna Loa 东北坡（约 3,000 英尺）一带；它不是单一品牌，也不是所有夏威夷茶都来自火山。1887 年茶传入夏威夷，1999–2001 年 USDA/ARS 与夏威夷大学 CTAHR 在 Waiakea 600 英尺、Mealani 2,800 英尺、Volcano 4,000 英尺建立无性系试验，Mealani 与 Volcano 的绿茶、乌龙品质表现优秀。Big Island Tea 于 2001 年建立，在 Mauna Loa 约 3,000 英尺的火山灰茶园做小批次手工绿茶和红茶；Volcano Winery 在 Kilauea 山顶约 4,000 英尺，2005 年取枝条、2006 年定植、2011 年达 1 英亩；Tea Hawaii 在 Volcano Village 做原生林农林复合。公开材料没有统一的“火山矿物味”感官标准，不能把火山灰土壤直接等同于固定风味。

title: Hawaii Volcano Green Tea
summary: Hawaii volcano green tea is a regional name for green tea grown on the volcanic highlands of Hawaiʻi Island, especially around Volcano at about 4,000 ft and the north-east slope of Mauna Loa at about 3,000 ft. It is not a single brand, and not all Hawaiian tea comes from volcanic highlands. Tea was introduced to Hawaiʻi in 1887. In 1999–2001, USDA/ARS and the University of Hawaiʻi CTAHR established clonal trials at Waiakea (600 ft), Mealani (2,800 ft) and Volcano (4,000 ft); Mealani and Volcano produced excellent green and oolong tea. Big Island Tea, founded in 2001, makes small-batch handmade green and black tea on a volcanic-ash garden at about 3,000 ft on Mauna Loa. Volcano Winery, at about 4,000 ft near the Kilauea summit, took cuttings in 2005, planted in 2006, reached one acre by 2011 and makes black and white tea. Tea Hawaii works in native-forest agroforestry at Volcano Village. Public sources do not give a single “volcanic mineral” sensory standard, so volcanic-ash soil cannot be treated as a guaranteed flavour.

title: 美国南方甜冰茶
summary: 美国南方甜冰茶（sweet tea）是美国南部，尤其南卡罗来纳、佐治亚等地的甜味冰茶饮用方式，不是茶类、品种或品牌。做法通常是把红茶浓泡，趁热加入大量糖溶解，冷却后倒入装满冰块的杯中，常配柠檬。1878 年出版的《Housekeeping in Old Virginia》（常被后世文章记作 1879 年）给出已知较早的书面“Iced Tea”配方：一夸脱沸水、两茶匙绿茶，过滤后倒入放冰和每杯两茶匙糖的杯中，可加柠檬；这是“冰茶加糖”，不是现代热泡加大量糖的浓缩甜茶。南卡州 1995 年把甜茶定为“州好客饮品”；Summerville 自称“甜茶发源地”，官方旅游页的措辞是“历史似乎表明如此”，2016 年当地用 2,524 加仑甜茶创吉尼斯纪录。甜茶的起源没有确证，不能把地方叙事写成定论。

title: Southern Sweet Tea
summary: Sweet tea is a southern United States way of drinking iced tea, especially associated with South Carolina and Georgia; it is not a tea category, cultivar or brand. The usual method is to brew black tea strong and hot, dissolve a large amount of sugar while the tea is still hot, cool it, and pour it over ice, often with lemon. An early published “Iced Tea” recipe appears in the 1878 edition of Housekeeping in Old Virginia (often cited as 1879): one quart of boiling water and two teaspoons of green tea, strained and poured over ice with two teaspoons of granulated sugar per glass, with lemon optional. That is “iced tea with sugar”, not the modern concentrate sweetened heavily before cooling. South Carolina designated sweet tea its official “state hospitality beverage” in 1995. Summerville calls itself the “Birthplace of Sweet Tea”, but the official tourism page hedges with “history seems to indicate such”; in 2016 the town used 2,524 gallons of sweet tea to set a Guinness record. The origin of sweet tea is not established, and local legend should not be presented as proven history.

title: 保禄乌龙（Trà Ô Long Bảo Lộc）
summary: 保禄乌龙（Trà Ô Long Bảo Lộc）是越南林同省保禄（Bảo Lộc）一带的乌龙茶产区与产品家族，不是单一品牌，也不是“越南铁观音”的同义词。保禄位于海拔约 800 米的林同高原，夜间和清晨多雾、昼夜温差大，土壤为深厚风化的玄武岩土。当地茶园由本地种、Shan 种和引进的乌龙品种共同构成。保禄乌龙出口俄罗斯、法国、美国、印度、日本、泰国、印尼、新加坡、台湾、香港和中东；Bao Loc VN、Kim Điền 等企业各有不同规模。

title: Bao Loc Oolong Tea
titleAlt: 保禄乌龙（Trà Ô Long Bảo Lộc）
summary: Bao Loc oolong (Trà Ô Long Bảo Lộc) is a tea region and a family of oolong-style teas from Bao Loc in Lam Dong, Vietnam. It is not a single brand and not a synonym for “Vietnamese Tieguanyin”. Bao Loc sits at about 800 m on the Lam Dong plateau, with cool nights, thick morning fog and a large day-night temperature swing; its soil is deeply weathered basalt, rich in minerals and both well drained and moisture-retentive. Local gardens grow local seed tea, Shan tea and introduced oolong cultivars. Bao Loc oolong is exported to Russia, France, the United States, India, Japan, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore, Taiwan, Hong Kong and the Middle East. Bao Loc VN and Kim Điền operate at different scales.

title: 越南莲花茶
summary: 越南莲花茶是用绿茶窨入莲花香气的花茶，核心产区在河内西湖的 Quảng An 村。传统高香工艺取莲花花蕊（gạo sen）与太原绿茶反复窨制、干燥，历时约 15–21 天；也有把茶叶放进莲花花心过夜的简化做法。成品带轻微涩感、甜尾和纯净莲香。

title: Vietnamese Lotus Tea
summary: Vietnamese lotus tea is green tea scented with lotus. The traditional centre is Quảng An village on Hanoi’s West Lake, where makers use the hundred-petal Bach Diep lotus. The high-aroma method gathers the flower anthers, layers them with Thái Nguyên green tea and repeats scenting and drying for roughly 15–21 days; a simpler method stuffs tea into a fresh lotus overnight. The best cups are lightly astringent, sweet at the finish and cleanly floral.

title: Mộc Châu Oolong（木州乌龙）
summary: Mộc Châu Oolong 是越南山罗省木州高原的乌龙茶产品家族，不是单一品牌，也不是单一茶树品种。越南国家旅游局页面把木州描述为海拔 1,054 米、拥有越南最大茶园景观的区域之一。可核实的生产主体包括 Mộc Sương 和 Tân Lập：Mộc Sương 官网称 2005 年从台湾引入乌龙茶种、种下 20 公顷，茶园海拔 1,250 米；2010 年推出 Thanh Tâm 和 Thúy Ngọc 两款乌龙；现有 30 公顷农场（茶与果树），2012 年启动生态旅游区。2025 年山罗省报报道，Mộc Sương 的四款乌龙获 OCOP 4 星，Tân Lập 的 Kim Tuyên、Tứ Quý 乌龙获 OCOP 3 星。OCOP 是越南“每乡一产品”评级，不是茶叶等级。官方材料没有给整个木州乌龙产区的统一品种、感官标准或价格。

title: Mộc Châu Oolong
summary: Mộc Châu Oolong is an oolong product family from the Mộc Châu plateau in Sơn La, Vietnam. It is not a single brand and not a single cultivar. Vietnam's national tourism board describes Mộc Châu as a plateau at 1,054 m with some of the country's largest tea-garden scenery. Two producers can be documented: Mộc Sương and Tân Lập. Mộc Sương's own page says it began in 2005 by bringing oolong stock from Taiwan and planting 20 ha; its tea garden is at 1,250 m; it launched Thanh Tâm and Thúy Ngọc oolong in 2010; it now has a 30 ha farm with tea and fruit trees and started an eco-tourism area in 2012. In 2025, the Sơn La provincial newspaper reported that four Mộc Sương oolong products held OCOP 4-star status and that Tân Lập's Kim Tuyên and Tứ Quý oolong held OCOP 3-star status. OCOP is Vietnam's “One Commune One Product” rural-product rating, not a tea grade. The official material does not give a single regional cultivar, sensory standard or price for all Mộc Châu oolong.

title: 富寿红茶（Phú Thọ Black Tea）
summary: 富寿红茶是越南富寿省的区域黑茶（chè đen，全氧化茶），不是单一品牌，也不是中国普洱式的后发酵黑茶。2026 年富寿省官方口径：全省约 14,500 公顷茶园、鲜叶 19.3 万吨、面积居全国第二；76 家加工企业、18 个传统茶村、12 个合作社、58 个种茶社、3,800 公顷种植区代码。黑茶约占加工量的 70%，出口中东、俄罗斯、中国、巴基斯坦、印度、印尼、英国等市场；2026 年前 7 个月出口约 3 万吨。它没有统一的感官标准，Orthodox 与 CTC 两条工艺路线并存。旧稿的“李朝贡茶”“19 世纪末最早红茶厂”“500 年野生大茶树”“雄王茶祖传说”都没有可靠来源，已删除。

title: Phú Thọ Black Tea
titleAlt: 富寿红茶（Phú Thọ Black Tea）
summary: Phú Thọ black tea is a regional fully oxidised tea from Phú Thọ Province in Vietnam, not a single brand and not a Chinese-style dark tea. The province's 2026 figures are about 14,500 ha of tea, 193,000 tonnes of fresh leaf and second place nationally by area, with 76 processors, 18 traditional tea villages, 12 cooperatives, 58 tea-growing communes and 3,800 ha under growing-area codes. Black tea is about 70% of processed volume; exports go to the Middle East, Russia, China, Pakistan, India, Indonesia and the UK, with about 30,000 tonnes exported in the first seven months of 2026. There is no single sensory standard, and Orthodox and CTC routes coexist. Old claims about Ly-dynasty tribute, a late-19th-century “first” black tea factory, 500-year wild tea trees and a Hùng King tea ancestor have no reliable source and are removed.

title: 水江古树茶
summary: 水江古树茶（Suối Giàng）是越南北部山区以百年 Shan Tuyet（雪茶）古树鲜叶制成的茶，核心在水江社，海拔约 1,300–1,400 米。它不是单一茶树品种，也不是官方等级；当地以古树群体、手工采摘和铁锅杀青、揉捻、晾晒为核心，成品从绿茶到红茶、白茶、乌龙和茶饼都有。行政上历史上属安沛省，2025 年省级合并后现属老街省。

title: Suoi Giang Ancient Tea
summary: Suoi Giang ancient tea is a place-based tea from old Shan Tuyet trees in the northern Vietnamese highlands, around 1,300–1,400 m. It is not a single cultivar or a statutory grade. The village makes green tea as its main product, but also black, white, oolong and pressed tea cakes. Administratively it belonged to Yen Bai until the 2025 provincial merger; it is now part of Lao Cai.

title: 越南茉莉花茶
summary: 越南茉莉花茶用绿茶窨入茉莉鲜花香气，是越南最日常的花茶。茉莉在傍晚至夜间开放、香气最盛时采摘，与干燥绿茶分层窨制；传统做法约 1 公斤茉莉花窨 1 公斤茶，可多次换花。成品香气清甜、汤色黄绿，适合热泡或冰饮。

title: Vietnamese Jasmine Tea
summary: Vietnamese jasmine tea is green tea scented with fresh jasmine blossoms. It is the everyday scented tea of Vietnam: jasmine is picked when its perfume peaks in the evening, layered with dried green tea, and traditionally about 1 kg of flowers scents 1 kg of tea. The result is sweet, clean and light, at home in a teapot or a glass of ice.

title: 盖碗
summary: 由盖、碗、托组成的灵活泡茶器，既能做主泡器，也能直接饮用。白瓷盖碗中性、易观察，是学习冲泡和比较茶样的常用器具。

title: Gaiwan
summary: A three-part vessel with a lid, bowl and saucer, used both for brewing and for drinking. A white porcelain gaiwan is neutral, easy to observe and a practical tool for learning and comparing teas.

title: 煮水器
summary: 用于烧水的壶或炉，材质与控温方式影响水温稳定性。能稳定达到并保持目标水温，比追求昂贵材质更重要。

title: Kettle
summary: A kettle or heating vessel for brewing water. Stable temperature control matters more than expensive materials; safety depends on the material, heat source and handling.

title: 茶壶
summary: 带壶嘴、把手与盖的冲泡器，材质与器型多样，保温性通常优于盖碗。出水、容量和顺手程度比外观更重要。

title: Teapot
summary: A brewing vessel with a spout, handle and lid. Materials and shapes vary widely, and heat retention is usually better than a gaiwan. Pouring, capacity and comfort matter more than appearance.

title: 品茗杯
summary: 用于饮茶的小杯，口沿、杯身与材质影响香气与入口感受。白瓷便于看汤色，杯口光滑和圈足稳定比造型更重要。

title: Tea cup
summary: A small cup for drinking tea. The rim, body and material affect aroma and the first impression in the mouth; a smooth rim and stable foot matter more than decoration.

title: 公道杯
summary: 用于承接泡好的茶汤并分杯，使每杯浓度更均匀。容量、出水和断水是选择重点，玻璃或白瓷便于观察汤色。

title: Pitcher
summary: A vessel that receives brewed tea and divides it among cups so each cup has a similar strength. Capacity, pouring and cut-off matter; glass or white porcelain makes the liquor easy to observe.

title: 《茶经》
summary: 唐代陆羽所撰三卷十篇茶学著作，系统整理茶的起源、器具、制作、煮饮、产地与史料。

title: The Classic of Tea
summary: Lu Yu’s three-volume, ten-chapter Tang-era treatise on tea: origins, tools, processing, vessels, preparation, history and producing regions.

title: 工夫茶
summary: 以小壶或盖碗、高投茶量与多次短泡为特征的饮茶方式，常见于闽南、潮汕与台湾。它是一套地方饮茶实践，不是全国统一的古礼。

title: Gongfu tea
summary: A tea practice built around small vessels, high leaf ratios and many short infusions, associated with southern Fujian, Chaozhou and Taiwan.

title: 日本茶道
summary: 以抹茶点饮为核心的日本茶道实践，融合寺院、武家与町人文化，形成多种流派与礼仪。它不是单一流派，也不是一成不变的古代仪式。

title: Japanese tea ceremony
summary: A structured practice centred on whisking matcha, shaped by temple, warrior and townsman cultures, with multiple schools and historical layers. It is neither a single school nor an unchanging ancient ritual.

title: 怎样读茶文化：一条阅读路径
titleAlt: How to read tea culture: a path
summary: 从人物与典籍进入，再看制度、贸易、地方礼俗与艺术，避免把传说当成史料。

title: How to read tea culture: a path
titleAlt: 怎样读茶文化：一条阅读路径
summary: Begin with a person and a book, then move through institutions, trade, local customs and art without turning legend into evidence.

title: 宋代点茶与斗茶
titleAlt: Song whisked tea and tea contests
summary: 宋代以碾茶、罗茶、候汤、点茶和击拂为核心的饮茶方式，以及比较汤花与茶色的斗茶习俗。不同文献的标准并不完全相同。

title: Song whisked tea and tea contests
summary: The Song practice of grinding, sifting, whisking and judging tea, including tea contests over foam and colour.

title: 陆羽
summary: 唐代茶学家，《茶经》作者，后世尊为“茶圣”。他的重要性在于把茶事整理成可比较、可传授的知识体系，而不只是留下若干泡茶口诀。

title: Lu Yu
summary: Tang-era tea scholar and author of the Classic of Tea, later honoured as the “Sage of Tea”.

title: 马拉喀什薄荷茶之路
titleAlt: The Marrakech Moroccan Mint Tea Road
summary: 以马拉喀什为中心的北非茶路，连接大西洋港口、阿特拉斯山南麓与撒哈拉边缘绿洲。中国绿茶经海上贸易进入摩洛哥，逐渐与新鲜薄荷、糖和本地待客礼俗结合，形成今天人们熟悉的摩洛哥薄荷茶。

title: The Marrakech Moroccan Mint Tea Road
summary: A North African tea corridor centred on Marrakech, linking Atlantic ports, the High Atlas and the Saharan edge. Chinese green tea entered Morocco through maritime trade and gradually joined fresh mint, sugar and local hospitality.

title: 西南古茶道
titleAlt: The Ancient Tea Road of Southwest China
summary: 古茶道是连接中国西南茶区（四川、贵州、云南）与周边地区的古老茶叶贸易通道网络。以四川蒙顶山为起点，经雅安、邛崃、宜宾等茶区，穿越云贵高原，连接贵州都匀、湄潭、遵义等茶区。这条路上的蒙顶甘露、都匀毛尖、湄潭翠芽、宜宾川红、邛崃黑茶等名茶，通过马帮和背夫运往各地。古茶道不仅是茶叶贸易之路，更是西南少数民族茶文化的传播纽带。

title: The Ancient Tea Road of Southwest China
summary: A network of pack-horse and porter routes linking the tea districts of Sichuan, Guizhou and Yunnan, from Mengding Mountain through the karst plateau to Kunming and the Pu'er tea country.

title: 阿拉伯茶路
summary: 连接印度洋茶产地与阿拉伯半岛、红海和黎凡特市场的海上—陆上贸易网络。印度红茶与中国绿茶经孟买、亚丁、摩卡、麦加、大马士革、开罗以及波斯湾的马斯喀特、迪拜流转，茶与咖啡、香料、朝觐和港口贸易交织。

title: The Arabian Tea Route
summary: A maritime and overland trade network linking Indian Ocean tea producers with Arabian Peninsula, Red Sea and Levantine markets. Indian black tea and Chinese green tea moved through Mumbai, Aden, Mocha, Mecca, Damascus, Cairo, Muscat and Dubai.

title: 大吉岭茶路铁路
summary: 大吉岭喜马拉雅铁路（Darjeeling Himalayan Railway）建于1881年，是连接印度西孟加拉邦西里古里与大吉岭的窄轨铁路，全长约88公里，1999年被列入联合国教科文组织世界遗产。这条“玩具火车”铁路是英国殖民者为将大吉岭茶园生产的优质红茶运往加尔各答港口出口而修建的。…

title: The Darjeeling Himalayan Railway
summary: A narrow-gauge mountain railway built to carry tea and people from the Darjeeling gardens to the plains, and a UNESCO World Heritage landscape.

title: 闽粤茶路
summary: 闽粤茶路是明清时期连接福建茶产区与广东出海港口的重要茶叶贸易通道。武夷山的岩茶、安溪的铁观音、福鼎的白茶经此路运往潮州、汕头、广州，再经海上丝绸之路出口至东南亚和欧洲。这条茶路不仅是茶叶贸易的动脉，更是功夫茶文化从闽南向潮汕传播的文化走廊。

title: The Fujian–Guangdong Tea Road
summary: A network of mountain paths, river boats and port routes linking Fujian’s tea districts with Chaozhou, Shantou and Guangzhou.

title: 韩国茶路
summary: 韩国茶文化有悠久的半岛饮茶传统，常被追溯到中国唐代。新罗时期（公元前 57—公元 935 年），入唐求法的僧人和留学生将茶种与饮茶习俗带回朝鲜半岛。828 年，新罗兴德王派使臣金大廉从唐朝带回茶种，种植于智异山（Jirisan），这是韩国茶史中最早明确记载的茶种种植，不宜扩大为绝对起点。…

title: The Korean Tea Road
summary: A mountain-to-coast tea geography linking Jirisan, Hadong, Boseong, Gyeongju and Jeju through temple gardens, wild tea woods and terraced plantations.

title: 京都江户茶路
summary: 京都江户茶路是日本江户时代（1603-1868）从京都通往江户（今东京）的官方驿道"东海道"上的茶叶贸易之路。京都宇治抹茶、奈良煎茶、静冈玉露等茶品，经东海道五十三次驿站，由"茶飞脚"（专业茶邮差）肩挑背扛或用马驮，送往江户城。日本浮世绘大师歌川广重《东海道五十三次》系列名画，生动记录了这条茶路上的风景。

title: The Kyoto–Edo Tea Road
summary: A composite history of the Uji tea country, the Tokaido highway and the movement of tea from Kyoto to Edo during the Tokugawa period.

title: 吉尔吉斯帕米尔茶路
summary: 从新疆喀什经伊尔克什坦、奥什、纳伦、比什凯克、塔什干到撒马尔罕的中亚茶路。砖茶经天山与帕米尔—阿赖山地进入费尔干纳盆地，与游牧社会的奶、盐和待客礼俗结合，形成中亚咸奶茶的日常传统。

title: The Kyrgyz Pamir Tea Road
summary: A Central Asian caravan corridor from Kashgar through Irkeshtam, Osh, Naryn, Bishkek and Tashkent to Samarkand. Brick tea entered the Tian Shan and Pamir-Alai highlands, where it joined milk, salt and pastoral hospitality.

title: 波斯茶路
summary: 波斯（伊朗）是丝绸之路上的茶叶贸易重镇，茶文化在波斯已有数百年历史。茶叶经丝绸之路从中国传入波斯的具体时间有不同说法，常被追溯到唐宋时期，但缺少单一的确证年代。波斯商人将中国砖茶和绿茶运至波斯，逐渐形成了独特的波斯茶文化——用萨玛瓦尔（Samovar，俄式茶炊）煮茶，以透明玻璃杯饮用，搭配藏红花冰糖（Nabat）和波斯甜点。…

title: The Persian Tea Road
summary: A trade and tea-culture corridor from Tehran across the Caspian gardens, the Iranian plateau and the bazaar cities to Tabriz.

title: 蜀道茶路
summary: 蜀道是关中与四川之间多条山地道路的统称；本页以金牛道一线为样本，讲茶、盐、布匹与官粮如何翻越秦岭—大巴山进入成都平原。它不是一条固定不变的古代商道，也不是现代徒步路线。

title: The Shu Road Tea Route
summary: The Shu Road is a family of mountain routes between the Guanzhong plain and the Sichuan Basin, not one fixed ancient highway. This article follows the Jinniu Road as a reading sample and asks how tea, salt, cloth and official grain moved through the passes into Chengdu.

title: 锡金大吉岭茶路
summary: 从印度加尔各答经西里古里、大吉岭、噶伦堡、甘托克到乃堆拉山口的喜马拉雅茶路。大吉岭红茶、锡金特米茶与跨境盐茶贸易在这条山地走廊上交汇，殖民茶园、山地铁路和边境口岸构成今天仍可读到的历史层次。

title: The Sikkim Darjeeling Tea Road
summary: A Himalayan tea corridor from Kolkata through Siliguri, Darjeeling, Kalimpong and Gangtok to Nathu La. Colonial tea gardens, the mountain railway, Temi tea and cross-border salt-and-tea trade form overlapping historical layers.

title: 南方丝绸之路茶路
titleAlt: The Southern Silk Road Tea Route
summary: 南方丝绸之路是从成都平原经四川、云南进入缅甸、印度东北部的多时代道路网络，不是一条自古不变的单条官道，也不是一条全程运茶的“茶路”。本页以成都—雅安—西昌—大理—保山—腾冲—八莫—密支那—帕凯山口—阿萨姆河谷—高哈蒂为阅读主线，用 32 个节点分层叙述先秦汉代的蜀身毒道、唐宋以后的茶马贸易、清代民国的普洱茶外销与 20 世纪的滇缅公路，不把“公元前四世纪最早茶路”“云南茶种直接传入阿萨姆”“阿霍姆人带来饮茶习俗”当作定论。

title: The Southern Silk Road Tea Route
summary: The Southern Silk Road is a multi-era network from the Chengdu plain through Sichuan and Yunnan into Myanmar and northeast India, not a single ancient highway and not a route that carried tea from end to end. This article follows a 32-station reading line from Chengdu through Ya'an, Xichang, Dali, Baoshan, Tengchong, Bhamo, Myitkyina, the Pangsau Pass and the Assam valley to Guwahati, separating the Han-era Shu-Shendu corridor, later tea-horse trade, Qing and Republican Pu'er exports, the nineteenth-century Assam plantation industry and the twentieth-century Stilwell Road. It rejects the claims of a fourth-century-BCE tea road, direct Yunnan-to-Assam tea-seed transmission and an Ahom origin for Assamese tea drinking.

title: 唐蕃古道
summary: 唐蕃古道是唐代长安与逻些之间的官方驿道，也是由主道、次道与支线组成的高原交通网络。本页按长安—河湟—玉树—查吾拉—拉萨的主线阅读样本重写 30 个节点，并把茶叶入藏与茶马贸易放在宋、明、清的历史层次里讲，不把 641 年文成公主入藏当作茶叶传入的确定起点。

title: The Tang–Tubo Road
summary: The Tang–Tubo Road linked Chang'an with Lhasa as an official corridor and a wider network of main, secondary and branch routes across the Tibetan Plateau. This article follows a thirty-station main-line reading sample and treats tea as a later Song–Ming–Qing trade story, not as a documented consequence of the 641 marriage mission.

title: 茶马古道
summary: 茶马古道是连接中国西南产茶区与青藏高原乃至南亚的古老贸易通道网络，始于唐宋，鼎盛于明清，延续千年。云南的普洱茶、四川的蒙顶甘露由马帮驮运，翻越横断山脉，跨越金沙江、澜沧江、怒江，抵达西藏拉萨，再经喜马拉雅山口通往尼泊尔、印度。这条古道不仅是茶叶贸易之路，更是汉、藏、傣、彝、纳西等多民族文化交流的纽带。

title: The Ancient Tea Horse Road
summary: A network of trade routes linking southwest China's tea regions with the Tibetan plateau and South Asia, shaped by horse caravans, Pu-erh tea and multi-ethnic exchange from the Tang to the Qing.

title: 蕃尼古道
summary: 从拉萨经后藏与喜马拉雅山口到加德满都的高海拔贸易走廊，茶叶、羊毛、盐与药材双向流动；10 个记录节点，约 880 公里。

title: The Tibet–Nepal Tea Road
summary: A high Himalayan trade corridor from Lhasa across southern Tibet to the Kathmandu Valley, carrying brick tea, wool, salt and manufactured goods.

title: 安南茶路
summary: 从云南普洱经江城、勐康进入越南北部，再经苏江古茶山、安沛、太原到河内的跨境茶贸易走廊；8 个记录节点，约 600 公里。

title: The Vietnam Tea Road
summary: A cross-border route from Pu’er through northern Vietnam’s tea mountains and the Red River plain to Hanoi.

title: 武夷磐安古茶路
summary: 从武夷山桐木村经下梅、庆元、景宁、磐安、天台山国清寺到杭州的闽浙高地茶路，7 个记录节点，约 480 公里；茶、盐与山货双向流动。

title: The Wuyi–Pan’an Ancient Tea Road
summary: A Fujian–Zhejiang highland route linking Wuyi rock tea, the tea-and-salt trails of Pan’an, and the markets of Hangzhou.

title: 滇缅印茶路
summary: 滇缅印茶路是从大理经保山、腾冲进入缅甸，再翻越帕凯山口到印度阿萨姆河谷的主题文化线路，不是一条自古不变的单条官道。本页用 20 个节点重写这条跨境走廊，把普洱茶西行、缅甸腌茶、阿萨姆十九世纪商业茶园与阿霍姆迁徙分开叙述，不把“云南茶种直接传入阿萨姆”当作单线起源。

title: The Yunnan–Burma–India Tea Road
summary: The Yunnan–Burma–India Tea Road is a thematic corridor from Dali through Baoshan and Tengchong into Myanmar, over the Patkai Pass, and down the Brahmaputra valley to Guwahati. This article separates the movement of Yunnan tea, Burmese pickled tea, the nineteenth-century Assam plantation industry and the Tai-Ahom migration, and refuses a single-line “Yunnan tea seed to Assam” origin story.

title: 张掖砖茶之路
summary: 张掖砖茶之路是明清时期从中国南方茶区经河西走廊通往新疆、蒙古乃至俄罗斯的重要支线茶路。湖南安化砖茶、湖北羊楼洞砖茶经汉水北上至襄阳，再经潼关、西安、兰州、武威抵达张掖，在此集散后分两路：一路向北经额济纳旗通往蒙古，一路向西经嘉峪关、敦煌通往新疆。张掖作为河西走廊咽喉，是这条茶路的重要中转站之一；旧站称古城内“仍有明清茶马司遗址和茶商大院”，这需要遗址与方志考证，本页作为地方记忆保留。

title: The Zhangye Brick Tea Road
summary: A late imperial brick-tea corridor from Hunan and Hubei through the Han River and the Hexi Corridor to Zhangye, Jiuquan and Jiayuguan.

title: 飞剪船茶竞之路
titleAlt: The Great Tea Clipper Race Route
summary: 19世纪中叶，英国每年新茶上市时，最快的飞剪船（Clipper Ship）从中国福州、上海、广州等港口装载新茶，展开横跨印度洋和大西洋的竞速航行，争夺‘第一船新茶’的荣誉与首船溢价。…

title: The Great Tea Clipper Race Route
summary: The nineteenth-century tea clipper race: fast sailing ships carrying new-season tea from Fuzhou to London, and the 1866 contest that became a legend.

title: 万里茶道
summary: 万里茶道是17世纪末至20世纪初连接中国南方茶产区与俄罗斯乃至欧洲的国际贸易通道，全长约13000公里，持续繁荣约200年。由晋商（山西商人）主导经营，从福建武夷山（或汉口）出发，经汉水北上中原，穿山西过雁门，越蒙古戈壁，跨西伯利亚针叶林，直抵莫斯科与圣彼得堡。…

title: The Great Tea Road
summary: The overland tea trade from Fujian and the Chinese interior across Mongolia to Siberia and European Russia, centred on the Kyakhta market and managed largely by Shanxi merchants from the late seventeenth to the early twentieth century.

title: 海上茶路
summary: 海上茶路是16-19世纪连接中国茶叶产区与全球市场的最重要海上贸易通道，也是海上丝绸之路的茶叶专线。从福建武夷山茶叶经福州、厦门、广州等港口装船，穿越南海、马六甲海峡、印度洋，绕过好望角或经苏伊士运河，抵达欧洲各大港口。正山小种、武夷岩茶、铁观音、凤凰单丛等中国名茶经此路走向世界，引发了欧洲的饮茶风潮和美国的波士顿倾茶事件。

title: The Maritime Tea Route
summary: The sea route that carried Chinese tea from Fujian and Guangdong to Southeast Asia, Europe and the Americas, and later linked the tea gardens of India, Ceylon and Kenya to global markets.

title: 丝路茶道
summary: 茶在丝绸之路的绿洲、草原与海陆贸易网络中流转，但不存在一条从西安直达莫斯科的单一“茶道”。本页以茯砖茶、青砖茶等紧压茶为线索，说明中亚、波斯—奥斯曼与北方草原—西伯利亚三条分支如何各自成立，并在节点表里标明示意里程不能连续累加。

title: The Silk Road Tea Network
summary: Tea moved through the oasis, steppe and maritime networks we call the Silk Road, but there was no single caravan road from Xi'an to Moscow. This article uses compressed brick tea to follow three separate branches: Central Asia and Persia, the Ottoman west, and the Kyakhta-Siberian north.

title: 荷兰东印度公司茶路
summary: 荷兰东印度公司（VOC，1602—1799）是欧洲早期大规模进口茶叶的贸易公司之一。17世纪初，VOC把中国和日本茶叶运抵阿姆斯特丹，推动了欧洲饮茶风尚。荷兰人以巴达维亚（今雅加达）为亚洲总部，经好望角连接中国、日本与欧洲，运回绿茶、红茶和乌龙茶。…

title: The Dutch VOC Tea Route
summary: The Dutch East India Company’s maritime tea route linking Amsterdam, the Cape, Batavia, Chinese ports and Nagasaki’s Dejima.

title: 巴西巴拉那茶路
titleAlt: The Brazil Paraná Yerba Mate Road
summary: 以巴拉那州马黛茶产区、库里蒂巴贸易网络、巴拉那瓜港与伊瓜苏三国交界为主题的文化线路。马黛茶是冬青科 Ilex paraguariensis 的叶片饮品，不是山茶科茶；本页把“茶路”作为贸易与文化的阅读框架，不把它写成一条连续的古代商道。

title: The Brazil Paraná Yerba Mate Road
summary: A thematic cultural corridor through Paraná's yerba mate districts, Curitiba's trading houses, the port of Paranaguá and the tri-border area at Iguaçu. Yerba mate is Ilex paraguariensis, not Camellia sinensis; the page treats the "tea road" as a reading frame rather than a single ancient caravan track.

title: 马黛茶路
summary: 马黛茶（Yerba Mate）是南美洲最具代表性的传统饮品，其历史可追溯至前哥伦布时期。瓜拉尼族（Guaraní）原住民将马黛树视为“众神赐予的圣树”，用葫芦和金属吸管（Bombilla）饮用马黛茶的传统延续至今。16 至 18 世纪，西班牙耶稣会传教士在巴拉那河流域（Paraná River）将野生马黛茶驯化种植，建立了成规模的种植园；“南美最大茶园”一类说法缺少遗址证据。…

title: The Yerba Mate Road
summary: A South American trade and culture corridor linking the Jesuit missions of the Paraná basin with the mate markets of Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay.

title: 中央咖啡馆
summary: 维也纳第一区赫伦街 14 号的传统咖啡馆，1876 年开业，位于费斯特宫底层。它因 19 世纪末至 20 世纪初的知识分子聚会而闻名；今天首先是咖啡馆，茶单是配角。

title: Café Central
summary: A traditional Viennese coffee house at Herrengasse 14, opened in 1876 on the ground floor of Palais Ferstel. It is known for its late-nineteenth and early-twentieth-century intellectual circles, but it is a coffee house first and a tea stop second.

title: 萨赫咖啡馆
summary: 维也纳国家歌剧院对面的萨赫酒店内咖啡馆，以 Original Sacher-Torte 为核心。读它要把 1832 年的创制传说、1876 年的酒店史和 1963 年前后的蛋糕争议分开。

title: Café Sacher
summary: The café inside Hotel Sacher, opposite the Vienna State Opera, built around the Original Sacher-Torte. Read it in three layers: the 1832 creation story, the hotel history from 1876, and the cake dispute around 1963.

title: 帝后饭店下午茶
summary: 费尔蒙特帝后饭店位于维多利亚内港畔，1908 年由加拿大太平洋铁路公司开设，是加拿大国家历史遗址。酒店的下午茶以“Tea at the Empress”名义经营，属于酒店内的英式下午茶传统，而非独立的街边茶馆。

title: Fairmont Empress Afternoon Tea (Victoria)
summary: The Fairmont Empress sits on Victoria's Inner Harbour. Opened by the Canadian Pacific Railway in 1908, it is a National Historic Site with 431 rooms, and its afternoon tea is a hotel experience rather than a standalone teahouse.

title: 老舍茶馆
summary: 老舍茶馆位于北京前门西大街正阳市场，1988 年开业，以作家老舍命名，集茶饮、京味小吃和曲艺、京剧等演出于一体。它是当代北京的代表性文化茶馆，不是老舍笔下的历史茶馆原址。

title: Lao She Teahouse
summary: Lao She Teahouse is on Qianmen West Street in Beijing, opened in 1988 and named after the writer Lao She. It combines tea, Beijing snacks and stage performances such as quyi, Peking opera and acrobatics; it is a modern cultural teahouse, not the original site of Lao She’s fictional teahouse.

title: 陶陶居
summary: 陶陶居 1880 年在广州西关第十甫路开业，是粤式茶楼“一盅两件”的代表之一。它经历 1925 年扩建、20 世纪末出租、2018 年收回与 2022 年重开，现由广州酒家集团经营，地址仍在第十甫路。

title: Tao Tao Ju (Guangzhou)
summary: Tao Tao Ju opened on Dishifu Road in Guangzhou's Xiguan district in 1880 and became a representative Cantonese tea house of the "one cup, two pieces" tradition. After a 1925 expansion, a late-twentieth-century lease, a 2018 recovery and a 2022 reopening, it is now operated by the Guangzhou Restaurant Group at its original Dishifu Road address.

title: 香港莲香楼
summary: 香港莲香楼源于 1889 年广州莲香楼，1927 年在中环开店，1996 年迁至威灵顿街。它 2022 年 8 月关闭，2024 年 4 月重开，2026 年 5 月迁往上环德辅道中 249—253 号，继续以手推点心车、盖碗茶和“一盅两件”经营。

title: Lin Heung Tea House (Hong Kong)
summary: Hong Kong's Lin Heung Tea House traces its brand to the Guangzhou Lin Heung of 1889 and opened in Central in 1927. It moved to Wellington Street in 1996, closed in August 2022, reopened in April 2024 and moved to 249–253 Des Voeux Road Central in Sheung Wan in May 2026, keeping its trolley dim sum, covered-bowl tea and "one cup, two pieces" service.

title: 陆羽茶室
summary: 香港中环的老式粤式茶楼，1933年创办，1976年迁至士丹利街；以酸枝家具、字画、旧招牌与点心和茶市闻名。
location: 中国 · 香港特别行政区

title: Luk Yu Teahouse
summary: A long-running Cantonese tea house in Central, Hong Kong, founded in 1933 and moved to Stanley Street in 1976; read it through rosewood furniture, calligraphy, old signage and the rhythm of tea and dim sum.

title: 湖心亭茶楼
summary: 湖心亭茶楼位于上海豫园九曲桥荷花池中央，是上海现存最古老的茶楼之一。建筑可追溯至 1784 年，1855 年起开设茶楼；经过 2023–2025 年保护性修缮，于 2025 年 7 月重新向公众开放。

title: Huxinting Teahouse
summary: Huxinting Teahouse sits in the middle of the lotus pond at Yu Garden’s Nine-Bend Bridge in Shanghai, one of the city’s oldest teahouses. The building dates to 1784 and became a teahouse in 1855; after restoration from 2023 to 2025, it reopened to the public on 10 July 2025.

title: 观音阁老茶馆
summary: 成都双流彭镇马市坝街的百年老茶馆，前身为清代观音阁；老虎灶、千脚泥地面、竹椅与盖碗茶仍在日常使用，2024年获联合国教科文组织亚太文化遗产保护奖优秀奖。

title: Guanyinge Old Teahouse, Peng Town
summary: A century-old tea house on Mashi Ba Street in Peng Town, Shuangliu, Chengdu, housed in a former Qing Guanyin shrine; its tiger stove, trodden-earth floor, bamboo chairs and gaiwan tea remain in daily use, and its restoration won a 2024 UNESCO Asia-Pacific heritage award.

title: 鹤鸣茶社
summary: 成都人民公园内的百年茶社，1923年创办，以竹椅、矮桌、盖碗茶、长嘴铜壶与公园里的日常茶生活闻名。

title: Heming Teahouse
summary: A century-old tea house in Chengdu’s People’s Park, founded in 1923 and known for bamboo chairs, low tables, gaiwan tea, long-spout copper kettles and the slow everyday life of a public park.

title: 紫藤庐
summary: 台北新生南路三段巷内的日式老屋茶空间，1981年改为茶艺馆，1997年指定为台北市定古迹；自2024年12月起闭馆整修。

title: Wistaria Tea House
summary: A Japanese-era wooden house in Taipei, converted into a tea house in 1981 and designated a city historical site in 1997; closed since December 2024 for a multi-year restoration.

title: 喀什百年老茶馆
summary: 喀什老城吾斯塘博依路与库木代尔瓦扎路交会处的百年茶馆，以茯砖茶、清茶、药茶、馕、土炕与木卡姆弹唱构成日常空间。
location: 中国 · 新疆维吾尔自治区

title: Kashgar Old Tea House
summary: A century-old tea house at the junction of Wusitangboyi and Kumudai’erwaza roads in Kashgar’s old town, where fu brick tea, clear tea, medicinal infusions, naan, earthen platforms and muqam music share one room.

title: 布拉格斯拉维亚咖啡馆
summary: 斯拉维亚咖啡馆在布拉格 Národní 街 8 号、正对国家剧院。它 1881 年在此开设，1884 年以 Slavia 重开，1931–32 年改为装饰艺术风格；它是捷克文学与异议政治的会面场所，不是专门茶馆。

title: Café Slavia, Prague
titleAlt: 布拉格斯拉维亚咖啡馆
summary: Café Slavia stands at Národní 8 in Prague, facing the National Theatre. A café opened on the site in 1881, it reopened as Slavia in 1884 and was remodelled in Art Deco style in 1931–32; it is a Czech literary and dissident meeting place rather than a specialised teahouse.

title: 费沙维咖啡馆
summary: 开罗汗·哈利利市场里的老咖啡馆，以镜子、薄荷茶与文学记忆闻名；读它时要区分创业年代的口述、家族记忆与可核验的记载。

title: El Fishawy Café
summary: An old café in Cairo’s Khan el-Khalili market, known for mirrors, mint tea and literary memory; read its founding date and famous visitors as layered claims, not a single verified story.

title: 安吉丽娜（巴黎里沃利街）
summary: 安吉丽娜 1903 年在巴黎里沃利街开业，是 Belle Époque 风格的沙龙式茶室与糕点店。它的招牌是浓稠的热巧克力 L’Africain 与栗子奶油蒙布朗；空间由 Niermans 设计，茶、咖啡与甜点在同一张菜单上。

title: Angelina, Rue de Rivoli, Paris
titleAlt: 安吉丽娜（巴黎里沃利街）
summary: Angelina opened on Rue de Rivoli in 1903 as a Belle Époque salon de thé and pâtisserie. Its signatures are the thick L’Africain hot chocolate and the chestnut Mont-Blanc; the Niermans-designed room serves tea, coffee and pastries on one menu.

title: 拉杜丽茶室
summary: 巴黎皇家街 16 号的甜点与茶室品牌，1862 年由 Louis Ernest Ladurée 创立。它的核心不是茶叶专门店，而是法式甜点、马卡龙与沙龙式饮茶。

title: Ladurée
summary: A Paris pastry and tea-room house at 16 Rue Royale, founded in 1862 by Louis Ernest Ladurée. Its core is French pastry, macarons and salon-style tea, not specialist tea retail.

title: 玛黑兄弟茶
summary: 巴黎玛黑区的法国茶叶进口商与茶室，1854年创立，1984年转向零售；读它要把品牌叙事、批发史与今天的茶单分开。

title: Mariage Frères
summary: A Paris tea importer and tea house founded in 1854, which only opened to retail in 1984; read the brand story, the wholesale history and today’s tea menu as separate layers.

title: 纽约咖啡馆（布达佩斯）
summary: 纽约咖啡馆 1894 年在布达佩斯纽约宫底层开业，是匈牙利文学与咖啡屋文化的核心空间。它首先是一间咖啡屋，不是专门茶馆；大理石柱、壁画、吊灯和现场音乐共同构成它的体验，2006 年按历史资料修复。

title: New York Café, Budapest
summary: New York Café opened in 1894 on the ground floor of Budapest’s New York Palace and became a centre of Hungarian literary coffee-house culture. It is a coffee house rather than a specialised teahouse; marble columns, frescoes, chandeliers and live music define the room, restored in 2006.

title: 雅加达巴达维亚咖啡馆
summary: 巴达维亚咖啡馆在雅加达老城一座 19 世纪初的荷印建筑内，1993 年由 Graham James 修复后开业。它以荷印与印尼混合菜、二层 Grand Salon 和正对 Fatahillah 广场的百叶窗为特色，不是传统茶馆。

title: Café Batavia, Jakarta
titleAlt: 雅加达巴达维亚咖啡馆
summary: Café Batavia occupies an early nineteenth-century Dutch colonial building in Jakarta’s old town and opened in 1993 after a restoration by Graham James. It is known for Dutch-Indonesian cooking, the first-floor Grand Salon and shutters facing Fatahillah Square, not for a traditional tea service.

title: 一保堂茶舗
summary: 一保堂茶舗创立于 1717 年，是京都寺町通二条的老字号日本茶铺，销售抹茶、玉露、煎茶等，并设有茶室“嘉木”供客人品饮。它是茶铺与茶室结合的经营场所，不是传统意义上的餐馆。

title: Ippodo Tea
summary: Ippodo Tea was founded in 1717 and is a long-established Japanese tea shop on Teramachi-dori in Kyoto. It sells matcha, gyokuro and sencha and has a tea room, Kiki, for tasting. It is a tea shop with a tea room, not a full-service restaurant.

title: La Mamounia 的茶室
titleAlt: The tea rooms at La Mamounia
summary: 马拉喀什 La Mamounia 酒店的两处茶室，放在一座由18世纪花园、铁路时代酒店与摩洛哥工艺共同构成的空间里阅读。

title: The tea rooms at La Mamounia
summary: Two tea rooms inside a Marrakech palace hotel, read through an eighteenth- century garden, a railway-era building, and the meeting of Moroccan craft and Art Deco.

title: 佩尔洛夫茶屋
summary: 莫斯科 Myasnitskaya 街 19 号的佩尔洛夫茶屋，1890—1893 年由 Roman Klein 建成，1895—1896 年改为中国风立面。它曾是俄罗斯帝国重要的茶叶贸易商号，1917 年后国有化，1998 年启动、历时约 12 年的修复后，于 2012 年重新营业。

title: Perlov Tea House (Moscow)
summary: The Perlov Tea House at 19 Myasnitskaya Street, Moscow, was built by Roman Klein in 1890–1893 and refaced in a Chinese style in 1895–1896. Once a major imperial tea merchant house, it was nationalised after 1917 and, after a restoration begun in 1998 and lasting about twelve years, reopened in 2012 as a tea and coffee shop.

title: 莱佛士酒店 Tiffin Room
titleAlt: Tiffin Room at Raffles Hotel Singapore
summary: Tiffin Room 在新加坡莱佛士酒店内，商号可追溯到 1892 年，1910 年迁入酒店，1976 年定名。它是一间北印度餐室，以 tandoor、铜制 tiffin 盒和桌边研磨香料为特色，不是独立茶沙龙。

title: Tiffin Room at Raffles Hotel Singapore
summary: Tiffin Room sits inside Raffles Hotel Singapore, with a business history going back to 1892, a move into the hotel in 1910 and its present name from 1976. It is a North Indian dining room known for tandoor cooking, copper tiffin boxes and tableside spice grinding, not a standalone tea salon.

title: 山龙内尔酒店下午茶
summary: 开普敦山龙内尔酒店 1899 年开业，位于桌山脚下的 Gardens 街区。酒店把下午茶安排在 Lounge 与 Windsor Table，供应 60 多种散叶茶和三层点心；这是一项 1989 年 11 月引入的酒店餐饮传统，不是独立茶馆。

title: Mount Nelson Afternoon Tea (Cape Town)
summary: The Mount Nelson Hotel opened in Cape Town in 1899, at the foot of Table Mountain in the Gardens district. Its afternoon tea is served in the Lounge and the Windsor Table with more than 60 loose-leaf teas and a three-tier stand; it was introduced in November 1989 as a hotel dining tradition, not as an independent teahouse.

title: 马德里希洪咖啡馆
summary: 希洪咖啡馆 1888 年在马德里 Recoletos 开业，是西班牙 tertulia 文学聚会的代表空间。1949 年在此创立 Café Gijón 小说奖；2025 年底出售、2026 年 4 月以 Capucchino Grand Café Gijón 重开，地址与旧空间保留。

title: Café Gijón, Madrid
summary: Café Gijón opened on Madrid’s Paseo de Recoletos in 1888 and became a symbol of Spanish literary tertulias. The Café Gijón novel prize was founded there in 1949; after a sale in late 2025 it reopened in April 2026 as Capucchino Grand Café Gijón, keeping the address and historic room.

title: 贝蒂斯茶室（约克）
summary: 贝蒂斯约克店在圣海伦广场，1937 年开业。它把瑞士糖果师的烘焙传统、约克郡茶的供应链和玛丽皇后号邮轮式内饰放在同一间茶室里；既可日常吃茶点，也可在贝尔蒙特厅预订一套下午茶。

title: Bettys Café Tea Rooms, York
summary: Bettys York opened on St Helen’s Square in 1937. It combines a Swiss confectioner’s baking tradition, Yorkshire tea and Queen Mary-inspired interiors in one café tea room, with everyday counter service and bookable afternoon tea in the Belmont Room.

title: 福南梅森钻石禧年茶沙龙
titleAlt: Fortnum & Mason Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon (London)
summary: 福南梅森 1707 年创立，181 Piccadilly 旗舰店四楼的 Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon 于 2012 年 3 月由伊丽莎白二世揭幕。它把百货公司的茶叶零售、正式茶席与钢琴伴奏放在同一层楼，是伦敦少见的“百货内茶沙龙”。

title: Fortnum & Mason Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon (London)
titleAlt: 福南梅森钻石禧年茶沙龙
summary: Fortnum & Mason was founded in 1707, and its Diamond Jubilee Tea Salon on the fourth floor of the Piccadilly flagship was opened by Elizabeth II in March 2012. The salon combines the department store's tea retail, a formal tea service and live piano in one floor, making it an unusual "tea salon within a department store".

title: 水泵房茶厅
summary: 巴斯水泵房是 18 世纪末建成的乔治式社交建筑，今天由 Searcys 经营为餐厅与茶厅。它把矿泉水泉眼、科林斯柱式大厅和英式下午茶放在同一空间里，和普通街边茶馆不是一类场所。

title: The Pump Room (Bath)
summary: Bath's Pump Room is a late-eighteenth-century Georgian social building, now run by Searcys as a restaurant and tea room. It combines a mineral spring, a Corinthian-columned hall and English afternoon tea in one room, which makes it different from an ordinary street teahouse.

title: 伦敦丽思酒店下午茶
titleAlt: Afternoon Tea at The Ritz London
summary: 伦敦丽思酒店 1906 年在皮卡迪利开业，下午茶在棕榈庭供应。它把路易十六风格的空间、三层点心、约 20 种散叶茶和正式着装要求放在同一套体验里，是酒店餐饮而不是独立茶馆。

title: Afternoon Tea at The Ritz London
summary: The Ritz London opened at 150 Piccadilly in 1906 and serves afternoon tea in the Palm Court. Its Louis XVI-style room, three-tier stand, roughly 20 loose-leaf teas and formal dress code make it a hotel ritual rather than a standalone teahouse.

title: 川宁茶店
summary: 伦敦斯特兰德街 216 号的川宁老店，1706 年由 Thomas Twining 开设，仍在同一地址经营。它是茶叶零售店与品牌旗舰店，不是传统英式下午茶沙龙。

title: Twinings Tea Shop (216 Strand)
summary: The Twinings shop at 216 Strand in London, opened by Thomas Twining in 1706 and still trading at the same address. It is a tea retailer and brand flagship, not a traditional English afternoon-tea salon.

title: 麦金托什茶室（柳树茶室）
summary: 格拉斯哥 Sauchiehall 街 217 号的茶室由 Catherine Cranston 于 1903 年开设，Charles Rennie Mackintosh 与 Margaret Macdonald 参与设计。它 2018 年修复重开，2024 年由国家信托苏格兰接管，2026 年更名为 The Mackintosh Tearooms。

title: The Mackintosh Tearooms (Willow Tea Rooms)
titleAlt: 麦金托什茶室（柳树茶室）
summary: The tea rooms at 217 Sauchiehall Street, Glasgow, were opened by Catherine Cranston in 1903, with interiors by Charles Rennie Mackintosh and Margaret Macdonald. Restored and reopened in 2018, taken over by the National Trust for Scotland in 2024 and renamed The Mackintosh Tearooms in 2026.
